findings.description: This bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Objects, including the uploaded vendor roster, are not explicitly protected with customer-managed or bucket-default encryption by this Terraform configuration.

The bucket does not set an ACL or public-access-block controls. Unlike the other data buckets, the configuration does not explicitly constrain public ACL or policy exposure, leaving access protections dependent on account defaults and external configuration.
Although the bucket ACL is private, no server-side encryption configuration is defined. Ledger export objects are therefore not explicitly encrypted at rest by this configuration.
This bucket has a private ACL but no server-side encryption configuration. Model artifacts are not explicitly protected by bucket-default encryption in the declared configuration.
This bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Runbook contents are not explicitly encrypted at rest through Terraform.
